app.name: FX Structure LAB
app.tagline: 在一个多语言结构化驾驶舱中整合市场数据、收益分析和面向客户的外汇对冲方案。
app.disclaimer: 仅供教育演示之用，不构成投资建议。价格、收益、概率、Greeks 和风险指标均为示意值，并非可执行市场报价。启用实时数据时，数据来自第三方，可能延迟、不完整或不可用。

home.eyebrow: 机构级外汇结构化工作台
home.headline: 从即期波动走向面向客户的对冲方案。
home.description: 用于市场状态分析、客户敞口翻译、结构筛选、收益分析和多语言客户沟通的机构级仪表盘。
home.marketCard: 实时或演示 FX 数据、即期趋势、已实现波动率和 Market Pulse。
home.structureCard: 与目标、约束和适当性一致的结构建议。
home.payoffCard: Garman-Kohlhagen 定价、Greeks 和情景收益比较。
home.summaryCard: 以主要机构客户语言提供技术版和客户友好版说明。

preview.regimeBadgeTitle: Regime is derived from the latest Volatility 1 reading versus its two-year distribution.
preview.regimeFrameworkTitle: The regime is anchored to the latest Volatility 1 reading versus the two-year distribution of that same realized-volatility series.
preview.quantileFramework: Quantile framework: calm if latest Volatility 1 is below Q25 ({q25}%), neutral if between Q25 and Q75 ({q75}%), stressed if above Q75.

calm.label: Market is Calm
calm.subtitle: Low-vol regime
calm.description: Stable market conditions, compressed risk premia, often trend-friendly but vulnerable to volatility shocks.

neutral.label: Normal / neutral regime
neutral.subtitle: Medium volatility
neutral.description: Typical market environment; volatility is trading inside its interquartile range.

stressed.label: Market is Stressed
stressed.subtitle: High-vol regime
stressed.description: Volatility is above its upper quartile and market pricing is reflecting a stressed backdrop.

forward.name: Forward
forward.note: Budget certainty for known USD outflow.

vanilla.name: Vanilla option
vanilla.note: Preserve upside while capping worst case.
